renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Throw the mind to the twelve-end again and again — day by day its strangeness falls away. Or let the fire of time rise from its own place and burn your city down — at the end, calm shines where it stood.

Burn the whole world of fancy till only man-ness is left standing in the mind-with-no-other. Or look for the tiniest real things inside your own body and the world — held to the end, the highest shows itself.

Even a thin weak power works: hold it at the twelve-range, walk it into the heart — and freedom is won. Or walk the whole world-course in order, gross and subtle and highest, till at its end the mind melts.

At every edge of everything, sit with Śiva-as-real — by the road-rules, the great rising. Or think this whole universe gone open: mind melts straight into it, and turns into the bowl that holds the melting.
Rest your eyes on a pot and leave the wall out of it — when it melts, you turn made-of-that. Rest them on a treeless mountain wall — mind melts into the state, and the end of circling is born.

renders.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms.

paragraphs.text: Chuck the mind at the twelve-end on repeat — weirdness wears off in days. Or let time-fire climb out of its own spot and torch your city — at the end, calm shines in the ashes.
Torch the whole fancy-world till only man-ness is left in the no-other mind. Or hunt the smallest real things in your body and the world — hold them to the end and the supreme shows up.
Weak power counts too: hold it at twelve-range, walk it home to the heart — freedom unlocked. Or run the full world-course in order till the mind melts at the finish line.
At every edge of it all, sit with the real Śiva — follow the road-rules, catch the big rise. Or call the whole universe open: mind pours in and turns into the bowl that holds the pour.
Eyes on a pot, wall deleted — when it dissolves you're made of that. Eyes on a bare mountain wall — mind dissolves in, and the death of circling is born.
